    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row))
    row = grid[r]
    for c, value in enumerate(row):
        if value not in (2, 8):
            continue
        left = 0
        x = c - 1
        while x >= 0 and row[x] == 1:
            left += 1
            x -= 1
        right = 0
        x = c + 1
        while x < len(row) and row[x] == 1:
            right += 1
            x += 1
        height = min(max(left, right) + (1 if value == 2 else 0), r)
        for d in range(1, height + 1):
            out[r - d][c] = value if d == height else 1
    return out
